section: Perspectives in Education · Ch — Teaching Methods
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: In a cooperative-learning technique developed by Robert Slavin, mixed-ability teams of 4-5 students study material together, then each member is individually quizzed; team scores are based on how much each member IMPROVED over their own past performance (not just raw scores), and top-improving teams are recognised. This technique is called:
explanation: STAD rewards individual improvement within a team context, motivating both weaker and stronger students to contribute — distinct from the Jigsaw Method, where each member holds a unique piece of content knowledge the group depends on.
